dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rpa3](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rpa3) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 136.935 depth occurred on Nov 20 2025 63km NW of Akelamo. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 1.5789 longitude 127.1375. It impacted 29417 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
